operating_rules.stop: New integrity/recovery/clock/guard failure pauses affected tests; no blind retry or new directory to erase uncertainty. trial5 is cause-unknown and its separate investigation remains deferred.
operating_rules.notifications: No manual mention for this contract/report. Only a necessary, already-authorized physical UI/card action while execution remains open and requires no chat reply uses current-session real mention plus receipt. Requests requiring a reply end normally.
operating_rules.foreground: Keep the original upgrade UI foreground. No P3-8/background expansion, automatic taps, native sender or custom collector replacement.
operating_rules.matrix_lifecycle: Only round13 is writable. Preserve v12 and all older contracts, matrices and original receipts. New PASS means a new offline evaluation, not an old physical PASS.
operating_rules.history_commands: Reuse the direct v12 EXECUTED PASS criteria; never repeat their commands. All required successor commands are offline readers or FC byte comparisons.
operating_rules.usb_admission: Require actual phone presence and an unoccupied private port. Use the installed exact APK verification in Phone.start; do not reinstall the previously verified APK. No automatic UI taps. Request only necessary authorized physical actions.
operating_rules.phone_admission: Before the live cold launch, use existing private ADB read-only power/keyguard checks for current awake/unlocked state. Request only necessary already-authorized physical action; no UI taps or system setting changes.
